dashboardQueries.name: c6512e1a-b968-4ff7-9681-26f001556458
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "conn" 
observer.hostname!=""
principal.ip!=""
target.ip!=""
$service=about.labels["service"]
principal.ip!="0.0.0.0" AND principal.ip!="255.255.255.255" AND target.ip!="255.255.255.255" AND target.ip!="0.0.0.0"
$service!=""
match:
    principal.ip
outcome:
    $count=count_distinct(metadata.id)
order:
    $count desc 
limit:
    15
